violated_contract: A date-time whose source marks it as GMT/UTC must be read as UTC, not in the user's timezone. The transcript-file importer read every date-time in a file name in the uploader's timezone, so a Zoom cloud-recording name such as GMT20240508-213012_Recording.transcript.vtt was stored shifted by the user's UTC offset, often onto the wrong day.
canonical_prevention: When a file-name or metadata parser reads a date-time, honour the zone the source states (Zoom's GMT prefix) before falling back to the user's timezone. A behavioural test imports a GMT-marked name under a non-UTC timezone and asserts the stored start is the stated UTC instant, beside a control name without the marker that is still read in the user's timezone.
